### Findings

| cost_proxy_margin_ratio |
| :--- |
| -1.0 |

The metric calculates the sum of sale price minus the catalogue cost proxy, divided by the sum of sale price [q1]. This analysis operates at the item grain and is filtered to the 'Complete' status population. The scope is restricted to executor-authorized products. No date filter was applied in q1; historical coverage was not audited.

### Limitations
* This SQL did not measure the total number of items sold or the distinct customer count, so the volume driving this ratio is unestablished.
* The `products.cost` field is a catalogue cost proxy; its subtraction from sale price does not establish actual gross profit or net profit.

### Action items (proposed)
* Query the total item count and distinct order count (`COUNT(item_key)`, `COUNT(DISTINCT order_key)`) for these Complete items to establish the transaction volume behind this negative margin ratio.
* Group the cost-proxy margin ratio by `products.category` or `products.name` to identify which specific authorized products are contributing most to the negative ratio.
